answer_1.quote: We evaluate models on our new Wizard of the Internet (WizInt) task, using its dedicated training set ...

answer_2.quote: We report perplexity, F1 and Knowledge F1 (KF1) metrics ...

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation using crowdworkers ... On each turn of the conversation the crowdworker is asked to check all attribute boxes that apply to the last turn.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each model response on knowledgeability, factual correctness, engagingness, consistency, and provide an overall engagingness score.
